CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub AbrirExtratoEmpresa_Click()
On Error GoTo Err_AbrirExtratoEmpresa_Click

    Dim stDocName As String
    Dim bSintetico As Boolean
    
    bSintetico = Me!Sintetico
    
    If (bSintetico) Then stDocName = "Custos Empresa Sem Financeira3"
    If (Not (bSintetico)) Then stDocName = "Custos Empresa Sem Financeira2"
    
    DoCmd.OpenQuery "CustoEmpresaZerar", acViewNormal, acEdit
    DoCmd.OpenQuery "CustoEmpresaArquivoMorto2", acViewNormal, acEdit
    DoCmd.OpenQuery "CustoEmpresaArquivoAtual2", acViewNormal, acEdit
    
    DoCmd.OpenReport stDocName, acViewPreview

Exit_AbrirExtratoEmpresa_Click:
    Exit Sub

Err_AbrirExtratoEmpresa_Click:
    MsgBox Err.Description
    Resume Exit_AbrirExtratoEmpresa_Click
    
End Sub
Private Sub Form_Activate()
    Me!Sintetico = False
    'If (DTFinal = "") Then
        'DTFinal = Date
        'Do While Day(DTFinal) <= 31
        '    DTFinal = DTFinal + 1
        '    If Month(DTFinal) <> Month(Date) Then
        '        DTFinal = DTFinal - 1
        '        Exit Do
        '    End If
        'Loop
        'DTInicial = DateSerial(Year(Date), Month(Date), ((Day(Date)) - (Day(Date)) + 1))
    'End If
End Sub
